Author: Primal Armor contributors
Name: Primal Armor
Description: Matches nearby players' Primal armor VFX to their jobs in your local view. For TW 7.25 and Dalamud API 13. Requires Penumbra, Glamourer, and your own compatible Primal assets; detects installed assets automatically.
Punchline: Match nearby players' Primal armor VFX to their jobs.
